Security Clearance Type: None/Not Required Security Clearance Status: Not Required At RTX , the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems.

With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

Collins Aerospace is a leader in technologically advanced, intelligent solutions that help redefine the aerospace and defense industry. With a comprehensive portfolio and deep technical expertise, we help customers meet the demands of the global market. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

Are you a dynamic leader with a passion for Avionics? Do you thrive in a collaborative environment where your technical expertise can make a real difference? At Collins Aerospace in Cedar Rapids, IA, we're looking for a Pr. Software Engineer to join our foundation software team.

You'll be leading the development, certification, and sustainment of foundation software for safety-critical military applications. In this role, you'll be responsible for managing the impacts to foundation software due to hardware obsolescence and customer driven changes to fielded products.

The scope of this effort includes military avionics components utilizing PowerPC based systems using LynxOS-178 operating system. The components include processing modules, ethernet nodes, commercial and high integrity ethernet switch modules. This role requires the ability to analyze requirements, software, and open problem reports.

This role will also require you to manage small development teams when software updates are required. What YOU Will Do: Lead Projects: You will serve as the software project engineer, supplying project management and technical direction during all program phases including pursuit, bidding, planning, execution, and sustainment.

Ensure Consistency: You will ensure consistency with Collins Aerospace technical engineering processes. Define Development Plans: You will help define development plans, ensure compliance with DO-178 and other certification requirements, and lead certification efforts through audits.

Guide Teams: You will lead a wide range of entry-level to highly experienced engineers. Communicate Effectively: You will communicate technical progress, risks, opportunities, financial data, and other project management information clearly and concisely.

What YOU Will Learn: Technical Expertise: You will enhance your technical skills in processing platforms and associated technologies. Leadership Skills: You will develop your ability to lead and manage software development teams, making impactful decisions and solving complex problems.

Qualifications You Must Have: Embedded C and Foundation Level Software Experience.

Typically requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) and minimum 8 years prior relevant experience or an Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 5 years of experience Qualifications We Prefer: We value teamwork and team players, those who know how to work with others to accomplish a goal, and those who mentor and grow other engineers.

We value people who demonstrate initiative, a strong desire to learn and grow, tenacity in completing tasks and meeting commitments, and an ability to adapt to change. We value people who show energy in their work. We value proactive self-starters who build sound, collaborative relationships.

We value leadership in every role you have, the ability to guide people and break down barriers to success.

We provide connectivity and managed data services to ensure safety and seamless communication for passengers, crews, and militaries, from aircraft and airports to air traffic management. Join us in creating solutions that connect the world, one flight at a time.

Company Description
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences.

We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service.

We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood.

NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.
Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.
Job Description
NBCUniversal’s Intellectual Property Analytics, Operations, and Technology (IPAOT) team supports NBCUniversal’s content globally. The team builds applications to support our internal legal intellectual property partners as well as platform operations on YouTube, TikTok, and Facebook.

The applications help monitor NBCUniversal titles across search engines, data sharing networks, and various content deliver pipelines. The data is collected by the team and analyzed internally to support business-decision driving initiatives at the company.

The IPAOT team at NBCUniversal is looking for a self-motivated, highly organized, proactive, and passionate problem solver who will assist with the design, build, and ongoing maintenance of content and rights management systems, as well as content delivery systems and pipelines.

We are looking for a Software Engineer who can comfortably execute full-stack development. You will collaborate with other Software Engineers and Operations Analysts. This is a fast-paced role that interfaces with the entire department and many other internal business units and stakeholders at NBCUniversal.

Assist with software development using Python to design and build available, scalable, and secure back-end web services and APIs for a variety of legal and intellectual property stakeholders, including software for platforms such as YouTube, TikTok, and Facebook
Assist in the management and troubleshooting of production systems and refactoring of existing applications to improve business processes
Implement systems designs and software design patterns to write maintainable, testable, and robust software and services
Integrate with third-party APIs, including designing, implementing, and troubleshooting API connections to ensure seamless interoperability between systems
Manage and troubleshoot distributed systems and services in a production environment

3+ years of professional software development experience with Python and JavaScript (ReactJs)
3+ years of experience using SQL and RDBMS, preferably MariaDB or MySQL
Experience with RHEL-based Linux Distributions (Oracle Enterprise Linux or CentOS)
Comfort with git and related processes such as git flow, forking / branching strategies, and pull requests / code reviews
Experience developing, using, and understanding APIs
Professional experience in Object Oriented Development
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Strong problem solving and analytical skills with attention to detail

Unit testing and mocking frameworks
CI/CD with build tools such as Jenkins/GoCD/GitHub Actions
Experience with networking and distributed systems
Familiarity with NOSQL database (Cassandra)
Understanding and using Message Queueing Systems (Apache Kafka / RabbitMQ)
Fully Remote: This position has been designated as fully remote, meaning that the position is expected to contribute from a non-NBCUniversal worksite, most commonly an employee’s residence.
This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. About Qompyl Qompyl is redefining trading by focusing on a hands-on, visual, and gamified strategy builder that empowers traders to create and refine their strategies with ease. Our core service is a mobile-first platform , emphasizing simplicity, accessibility, and real-time interaction.

We are building an interactive fintech product where performance, clean UX, and seamless integration between front-end and back-end systems are critical. Role Overview We are seeking a Full-Stack Developer with a strong front-end orientation , particularly in React Native , to help build and scale Qompyl ’s mobile-first trading platform.

While this is a full-stack role, the primary focus will be on mobile front-end development , user experience, and real-time data interaction. The ideal candidate is comfortable contributing to back-end systems (Python/FastAPI) but thrives in building intuitive, high-performance mobile interfaces.

This role is ideal for a front-end-leaning full-stack developer who enjoys building mobile experiences and can confidently collaborate on back-end systems. Key Responsibilities Front-End (Primary Focus) Develop and maintain mobile applications using React Native . Ensure high performance, responsiveness, and smooth UX across iOS and Android.

Integrate RESTful APIs and WebSocket services for real-time financial data updates. Implement state management solutions (Redux, Zustand, Context API, etc.). Build reusable UI components and contribute to scalable front-end architecture. Optimize rendering of live market data and strategy simulations.

Back-End (Secondary Contribution) Contribute to back-end systems using Python, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, and PostgreSQL . Support API design and integration between front-end and back-end services. Collaborate on performance optimization for real-time data handling. Participate in system architecture discussions.

General Responsibilities Maintain clean code standards and version control using Git/GitHub. Collaborate in sprint planning and delivery using Azure DevOps. Contribute to architectural decisions for scalability and maintainability. Foster strong communication and a collaborative team culture.

Requirements Strong experience with React Native in production environments . Solid experience in JavaScript/TypeScript . Experience integrating REST APIs and real-time WebSocket services. Experience building or contributing to mobile apps (iOS & Android).

Backend experience with Python and FastAPI (or strong willingness to work on backend components). Experience working with relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred). Understanding of responsive and mobile-first design principles. Strong communication skills in a remote startup environment. Nice to Have Experience with Flutter .

Experience in fintech or real-time data applications. Familiarity with financial data visualization libraries. Experience in early-stage startups. Docker and CI/CD familiarity. 💡 Please Note - Equity-Only Structure This is a part-time, equity-only role, suitable as a side engagement alongside a primary job or consulting work.

The position will transition to compensated status after the MVP launch and once funding or sustainable revenue is secured. If you're excited about joining an early-stage mission-driven startup and helping build a next-generation trading platform, we’d love to hear from you. Originally posted on Himalayas

Thumbtack helps millions of people confidently care for their homes.
Thumbtack is the one app you need to take care of and improve your home — from personalized guidance to AI tools and a best-in-class hiring experience. Every day in every county of the U.S., people turn to Thumbtack to complete urgent repairs, seasonal maintenance and bigger improvements.

We help homeowners know which projects to do, when to do them and who to hire from our growing community of 300,000 local service businesses. If making an impact inspires you, join us. Imagine what we’ll build together.
About the Machine Learning Infrastructure Team
At Thumbtack, our challenges span a wide range of areas, including search, recommendations, matchmaking, pricing, safety, content generation, fraud detection, and more. The ML Infrastructure team is responsible for centralizing, standardizing and evolving AI/ML infrastructure that enables these experiences.

We empower product engineering teams by providing scalable, high-performance systems that drive AI innovation at scale. To read more about some of the engineering challenges at Thumbtack, visit our engineering blog .
Challenge
As a Software Engineer on the ML Infrastructure team, you will work closely with product and platform engineering teams to build and evolve core AI platform capabilities. You will help design and improve systems that allow teams to develop, run, and scale GenAI-powered applications in production. Your work will directly support AI-driven experiences used by millions of customers and pros across the Thumbtack ecosystem.

Build and evolve core AI platform capabilities that enable teams to develop, run, and scale GenAI-powered applications across Thumbtack.
Contribute to the design, development, and deployment of scalable tools and infrastructure to support the efforts of our applied scientists, including traditional ML model training and serving systems, feature and data workflows, CI/CD, orchestration, deployment, and evaluation tooling.
Work hands on across the stack, from backend services and execution infrastructure to integrations with AI models and tooling.
Partner with senior engineers to evaluate next-generation AI infrastructure frameworks and tools that help product teams harness advances in AI.
Drive projects to completion with a strong focus on business impact and measurable outcomes.
Solve complex technical problems and stay up to date with advances in this rapidly evolving space.
In order to be successful, you must bring
1 to 3 years of professional software engineering experience.
Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and software design.
Proficiency in at least one major programming language, and the ability to work across multiple languages. Our primary stack includes Go and Python.
Experience working with relational or NoSQL databases such as Postgres or DynamoDB.
Demonstrated ability to use AI coding tools in day-to-day workflows and validate, critique, and refine AI-generated output
Comfort operating in a fast-paced environment with a certain level of ambiguity, especially when learning and picking up new technologies when projects require it.
You operate with a bias to action, quickly learning what is needed and taking decisive steps to move work forward in ambiguous, fast-paced environments.

Overview One Identity 's OneLogin team is seeking Senior Software Engineer s who operate with high ownership, strong technical judgment, and a bias for action. These roles are designed for engineers who identify and solve problems proactively — not just execute assigned work.

Senior Engineers at OneLogin are expected to operate as T-shaped engineers: deep in a primary domain while remaining capable across the stack (backend, APIs, cloud, and operations). You will play a key role in maintaining product velocity, improving system reliability, and reducing operational burden.

This is a hands-on role that includes on-call responsibilities and requires a strong commitment to modern engineering practices, including AI-augmented development. We are looking for engineers who take full ownership — design, build, test, deploy, and operate — rather than handing work off between silos.

In this role, you will execute and evolve an incremental modernization strategy (e.g., strangler fig), safely transitioning legacy systems into scalable services while maintaining reliability and system continuity.

Responsibilities Execute and evolve an incremental modernization strategy, safely transitioning legacy systems into well-bounded services while maintaining reliability and continuity
· Decompose monolithic systems incrementally using patterns such as strangler fig
· Manage coexistence between legacy and modern systems during transition
· Design clear service boundaries, contracts, and data ownership models
· Ensure backward compatibility and safe evolution of APIs and data during migration
· Improve performance, scalability, and maintainability as part of modernization efforts
· Identify and prioritize high-impact areas for migration based on risk and value Ideal Experience:
· Hands-on experience incrementally modernizing monolithic systems in production environments
· Experience with migration patterns such as strangler fig, parallel run, or phased rollouts
· Strong understanding of system decomposition, including service boundaries and data ownership
· Experience maintaining backward compatibility and managing API/data contracts during system evolution
· Experience working with legacy systems and evolving them under real-world constraints
· Experience debugging and validating behavior across both legacy and newly extracted services
· Ability to balance migration velocity with system stability and risk
· Familiarity with observability practices to validate system behavior during migrations
· Experience using AI tools to analyze legacy systems, understand behavior, or accelerate refactoring and migration efforts Qualifications Software Development 4+ years of professional software engineering experience with ownership of production systems and operational improvements Strong backend development experience (Ruby, Node.js, or similar) Solid understanding of REST APIs, service contracts, distributed systems, and common software design patterns Experience working across backend systems, APIs, and production environments Quality & Testing Hands-on experience with automated testing across unit, integration, and API layers Strong ownership of code quality, including testing, debugging, and validation AWS & Cloud-Native Experience Experience building and operating cloud-native services in AWS Familiarity with CI/CD practices and modern deployment workflows Observability & Production Operations Experience using observability tools (e.g. Datadog or equivalent) to monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve production issues Familiarity with incident response and continuous reliability improvements On-Call & Incident Response Willingness to participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation and support production issue resolution AI-Augmented Engineering Experience with or strong interest in AI-assisted development tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Cursor) and the ability to effectively evaluate AI-generated solutions Company Description One Identity enables organizations of all sizes to better secure, manage, monitor, protect, and analyze information and infrastructure to help fuel innovation and drive their businesses forward. Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company. We free people and agents to ship what’s next.
For more than a decade, Vercel has shaped how the web is built. As the team behind Next.js, v0, and AI SDK, we create products that help builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.
Now, software is entering a new era, and the next generation of products will not just be used by people. They will be built, extended, and operated by agents.
We are building the platform for that future, trusted by companies like OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide . Whether you’re building our products, supporting our customers, growing our community, or shaping our story, you’ll help define what comes next.

Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented.
The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand.

But International Fintechs and non-US banks are left with two unsatisfying options to access it: Either they build on legacy clearing banks that are slow and unreliable, or they interface with middleware providers that don’t move and hold the dollars directly, but themselves rely on underlying legacy banks.

Augustus collapses this stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code.
We are a group of operators, unicorn early employees, ex-founders and people who walked away from degrees because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and n8n.
We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe.

You're a super IC in a small, elite engineering team. You work on core banking systems and own projects end to end. You take on big projects, drive them yourself, and deliver.
You work with engineering, product, and clients. You turn complex financial problems into clean code. You're trusted with the big calls from day 1; system design, technical tradeoffs, what we build and what we don't. The team is small on purpose, that means you have a lot of ownership, you move fast, and you make decisions that actually matter.
You're part of the product engineering team building the Programmable Bank - a bank for the new age of money movement, built around Digital Assets and AI. Your team builds the banking core across bare metal central bank infrastructure and blockchain infrastructure. We're building a Swiss clock: your job is precision engineering, translating a complex system into simple, clean code that runs reliably at scale.
Your First Six Months
Understand the codebase and increase your ownership rapidly.
Months 1-2: You ramp up fast. Understand the codebase, the domain, the product and ship meaningful code in your first weeks. Pick up a major project as an IC and start driving it. You're pairing with the team but operating independently early.
Months 3-4: You've shipped your first big project end to end. You know the domain well enough to push back on product decisions when something doesn't make sense. You're starting to influence technical direction - how we model data, how we handle edge cases, where we take shortcuts and where we don't.
Months 5-6: You're one of the people the team relies on for the hardest problems. You scope and drive projects autonomously. You have strong opinions on how the core banking systems should evolve and you're acting on them. Junior engineers come to you because your code is clean and your thinking is clear.

Relentless: You can't leave something broken. You don't stop because it got hard or because no one is watching.
Set The Bar: You're harder on yourself than anyone else would be. You don't need external accountability to care about quality.
Shape The Game: You don't wait for a playbook and you don't need one. You walk into genuinely new territory and figure it out. You move before anyone asked you to.
Systems First: You don't solve problems by adding people or effort. You build systems that make the problem smaller. Your first instinct is to automate, not to handle it manually.

FRYTE is redefining how electric logistics connects with the energy grid.
From our base in Munich, we're building the intelligence layer that powers the transition from diesel to electric freight.
Our SaaS platform enables fleet operators, dispatchers, and charge point operators to plan, optimize, and monetize electric truck charging — aligning fleet efficiency with grid stability.
Our vision: replace big oil with smart electrons.
Our mission: get e-trucks on the road – faster, smarter, more efficiently.
Tasks
This is a deep technical role for someone who wants to go deep , not climb an org chart.
You'll be the technical anchor of our backend — the engineer who sets the quality bar, owns the hardest design decisions, and quietly makes the whole system more robust and scalable. The person the rest of the team brings their thorny problems to, and who's genuinely happy to dig in.
We're explicit about this: this is an IC role with a Staff Engineer trajectory. No management obligation, ever. Your influence comes through architecture, code, and mentorship — not headcount. If your idea of growth is becoming the person whose judgement defines how a system is built, this is for you.
One note on the title, because it travels badly between companies: we don't measure seniority in years, or in features shipped inside one familiar framework. We measure it in scope of ownership — systems you were responsible for when they broke, designs you had to revisit once reality showed up, assumptions that scale quietly humbled. Most good engineers learn that lesson several times, usually the annoying way. We'd rather hire someone who already has.
You'll work directly with the founders (former TUM researchers with deep energy + logistics expertise) on the integration layer that makes electric freight actually work: multiple domains, real production traffic.

Own the architecture and production-hardening of our backend as we scale from seed onward
Design and version stable, multi-domain APIs (multiple integrations, real-time data streams)
Build the observability backbone — logging, tracing, metrics — so we operate with confidence, not hope
Raise the bar across the codebase: patterns, ADRs, reviews, and the unglamorous work that keeps things maintainable
Mentor and unblock the team through code and conversation — lift everyone's ceiling
Move fluidly into DevOps, SRE, or frontend when that's what the problem needs
Our Stack
Backend: Python, FastAPI, Postgres, PostGIS
Frontend: React, TypeScript
Infra: AWS

A track record of owning production backend systems in Python (FastAPI) on SQL/Postgres — not just building in them. Carrying something you designed through deployment, failure, and the redesign that followed. (That depth usually takes 5+ years to earn; the years themselves aren't the point.)
Strong backend and system design instincts — you reason about boundaries, failure modes, and versioning before you write the first line
Architectural depth, ideally in charging, fintech, scheduling, or similarly stateful, integration-heavy domains
A habit of operating across boundaries — backend, infra, the occasional frontend fix, sometimes code you had no business touching — because the problem never cared what your job description said
A teaching reflex: you have an answer to most things and you're happy to share it
Bonus: GitHub Actions, observability tooling (tracing/logging/metrics), SRE practices, and a track record of maintaining or contributing to OSS — because you find it fun .
Most of all: we hire for trajectory and attitude. We're looking for the humble, curious expert who's a mentor and coach by instinct — not because it's in the job description.

s.h: Your playing field Here's why this role matters for our mission.
s.t:
Teamwear is one of our three company headlines, but technically it currently depends on one person.
As long as this remains the case, the area cannot scale beyond its current scope.
Your goal: To enable Teamwear to scale beyond its current scope.
How you'll make a difference This is how you move our mission forward every day.
Data Pipelines: You build and maintain data pipelines for automated data collection, structured so that new sources and markets can be added quickly.
Algorithms: You develop algorithms to extract relevant information from websites and images.
Data Quality: You ensure data quality through validation, confidence levels, monitoring, and clean handovers internally and to partners.
Data Infrastructure: You manage and further develop the data infrastructure of the Teamwear area.
Technical Point of Contact: You act as the second technical point of contact for the Teamwear area.

s.h: In addition to your core responsibilities, you will also
s.t:
Internal Tools: You develop internal tools that enable the team to collect and correct data themselves.
Analytics & Reports: You create analytics and reports for internal stakeholders and external partners.
What you bring to the table We're not looking for a perfect CV. But you should recognise yourself in these points.
Broad Technical Skillset: You move between data pipelines, backend and some frontend, and are not afraid of AI or image analysis.
Data Automation: You have experience with automated data pipelines, web scraping and image processing.
Databases & Data Modelling: You have expertise in databases and data modelling.
Independent Working: You work independently, even when there is no second engineer in the room and the context comes from business teams.
Fast Learner: You quickly get familiar with unfamiliar domains and ask the right questions along the way.
80/20 Mindset: You know when fast and good enough is the right approach and when the data needs to be 100% accurate because a decision is based on it.
Data Quality: You care about details when it comes to data quality and make uncertainties explicit.
Data-Driven Thinking: You don't stop at analysing the data. You identify what is in the data, what it means and what we should look at next - even if nobody asked.
Engineering Practice: You write clean, maintainable code and follow good engineering practices such as testing and code reviews.
Tools: Python, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Grafana, Metabase, Pulumi, Kubernetes, AWS, LLM APIs
Good to know
We want you to know what this role really looks like from day one.
If you are looking for clearly defined tickets, a large engineering team and a finished tech stack, this role is probably not for you. You will work largely as a team of two within Engineering. Most of your day-to-day work will be with business people, not engineers.
You have two connections: technically to Engineering and on the content side to the Teamwear team. This gives you a lot of freedom and means you need to set your own priorities.
A large part of the role is data collection and data quality, rather than greenfield ML. The exciting part is turning messy, real-world sources into reliable data.
The area is new. There is no finished setup for you to work with - you will help build it.
AI-first: We work AI-first, and AI tools are an active part of our workflow.
Bonus Not a must - but this'll definitely earn you extra points.
Experience with AWS, Kubernetes or IaC (Pulumi/Terraform). You can also learn this with us.
Experience presenting and preparing data for non-technical audiences.

At ExtraHop, we’re on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes.

Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running.
Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you’d like to spend the next chapter of your career, we’d love to hear from you.

As a Software Engineer on the Framework team, you will work on complex development challenges, participate in technical design within your area, and play a meaningful role in shaping how we build and scale the systems that power ExtraHop's core products.

You will work closely with cross-functional partners in Engineering, Product, and Security to deliver customer-facing features that enable detection, visibility, and automation at scale.

This role is ideal for an engineer who brings technical depth, exercises sound judgment independently, and is motivated to grow their impact through excellent engineering and active collaboration.
Our team builds high-performance network detection and monitoring systems that operate at scale across increasingly complex protocols and data volumes. Our services and features are written primarily in C and C++ with a focus on security, scalability, stability, and reliability. Our team is focussed on enhancing, maintaining and optimizing core components of the system and functional areas related to protocol parsing, metrics publishing, continuous packet capture and Time Series DB.
This role focuses on designing and optimizing these core systems with an emphasis on performance, reliability and deep protocol awareness. You will work on next generation initiatives including scaling and performance improvement efforts, evolution of our data storage architecture (custom to open-source based) and early steps towards a cloud enabled model.

Design, develop, and maintain high-performance services for ExtraHop's core Framework systems, taking ownership of moderately complex to complex features with limited guidance.
Work across networking layers to implement and enhance protocol support
Participate actively in technical design discussions, contribute to architecture decisions within your team, and author clear technical documentation for your work.
Engage fully in agile development processes, including sprint planning, code reviews, and retrospectives; hold a high bar for code quality and test coverage.
Collaborate with Product and cross-functional engineering partners such as platform , infrastructure and cloud teams to translate business requirements into well-scoped, scalable engineering solutions.
Investigate, diagnose, and resolve production and performance issues independently; conduct root-cause analysis and implement preventive measures.
Contribute to platform modernization efforts and help evaluate and adopt new technologies or frameworks in partnership with senior and principal engineers.
Participate in on-call rotations and improve system observability, reliability and operational readiness.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, STEM, or a related field requiring systematic and analytical thinking.
4+ years of professional experience designing and delivering production software.
Strong expertise in C and C++ and other languages such as Go and Python.
Experience developing on Linux Systems (multi threading, memory management, IPC etc)
Proven ability to build and maintain performance critical systems.
Proven ability to debug complex issues (eg. using gdb, coredumps, performance tools)
Strong understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, packet processing etc)
Strong command of data structures, algorithms, and software design principles, with the ability to decompose complex problems into clear, actionable engineering tasks.
Self-starter who can operate independently, manage competing priorities, and drive work to completion with minimal oversight.
Excellent collaborator and communicator with a growth mindset and customer-first orientation.

Experience with network protocols (eg. HTTP, SMB, Kerberos, TLS, Microsoft protocols or similar)
Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS preferred) or distributed systems
Experience with observability, on-call practices and production systems
Scripting experience (Python or similar)

ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution.

By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments.
This comprehensive approach and market innovation have earned ExtraHop unique recognition as the only NDR vendor acknowledged as a leader by all major analyst firms, including the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant for Network Detection and Response™, the 2025 Forrester® Wave for Network Analysis and Visibility, the 2024 IDC® Marketscape for NDR, and the 2025 Gigamon® Radar Report for Network Detection and Response.

Since 2007, ExtraHop has consistently helped organizations worldwide extract in-depth network telemetry and contextual insights, affirming its commitment to protecting and empowering the connected enterprise.

Great financial package - Including salary, bonus, pension, private healthcare, share save scheme, flexible working & holiday policy along with a number of other benefits.

About Zuora
At Zuora, we help businesses grow smarter and adapt faster. Our platform powers modern business models — from subscriptions and usage-based pricing to AI-driven and outcome-based offerings — helping companies launch new products, automate complex billing, and unlock predictable, recurring revenue.
We’ve led the Subscription Economy for more than a decade. Now we’re evolving again by building the definitive platform for quote to cash and helping companies monetize their products and services with an adaptable, AI-ready foundation.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who is motivated to design, develop, test, and operate cutting-edge, highly scalable enterprise SaaS applications, and who can own significant components end-to-end while raising the technical bar around them.
Location & Work Arrangements
This role is based in our Foster City, CA office and follows a hybrid work model . Team members are expected to work onsite three days per week to foster collaboration, innovation, and team connectivity.
This is not a fully remote position .

Work with product management and other engineering teams to design, build, and operate Zuora's next-generation Revenue product.
Design and develop highly flexible common components and APIs that enable product customizability and extensibility.
Own the design and delivery of significant features or components within the team, from design through production support.
Design and develop application components and services for scale, using modern backend and cloud-native patterns, including microservices, APIs, and event-driven integrations where appropriate.
Understand the platform needs of other functional areas and provide design and development assistance as required.
Understand user needs and build products that are intuitive and easy to use.
Advocate for high-quality software and promote best practices to produce reliable, maintainable, and fault-tolerant systems.
Participate in and help facilitate design and code reviews, raising the bar on engineering practices, code quality, observability, and testability.
Mentor mid-level and junior engineers through pairing, code review, and technical guidance.
Identify technical debt within your area and propose pragmatic ways to address it alongside feature work.
Help drive Zuora's transition to microservices and cloud-based architecture.

BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a relevant degree.
8+ years of software development experience specializing in enterprise SaaS software.
Strong programming experience in Java, Python, or another object-oriented language.
Strong database and SQL knowledge, including Oracle or MySQL, data modeling, query analysis, transactions, and performance tuning. Plus experience with MongoDB and Redis.
Experience designing and building web applications, with expertise in related concepts such as web services, SOA, RPC (REST, gRPC, Thrift), and API design.
In-depth knowledge of common algorithms, data structures, design patterns, and their applications.
Experience with production software delivery, CI/CD, observability, troubleshooting, and operational ownership.
Track record of owning features or components end-to-end, from design through production.
Good verbal and written communication, including the ability to explain technical decisions clearly to teammates and cross-functional partners.
A demonstrated AI-first approach to engineering, leveraging AI across the design, development, and testing lifecycle to accelerate delivery, and drive impact beyond core areas of expertise.

Hands-on experience with Cloud and DevOps technologies (Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Kafka, AWS services).
Experience implementing and operating performant, scalable distributed systems, particularly a SaaS product.
Exposure to big data and NoSQL technologies.
Familiarity with web application and UI concepts like AJAX, SPA, and sessions.
Experience in payments, billing, financial systems, or other high-scale transaction platforms.
Experience mentoring or coaching junior engineers.

About Limetax
Limetax is building the agentic-first accounting and tax group for German SMEs.
We acquire established accounting and tax advisory firms and onboard them to our proprietary agentic platform, combining deep industry expertise with AI-native technology.
Backed by $40m in equity and debt from top-tier investors, we're building and scaling a new kind of accounting & tax group in Germany.
Our founders bring significant experience across M&A, operations, and AI-native technology, having previously built and scaled unicorns, Razor Group and Augustus.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer , you'll work from our Berlin HQ at the intersection of engineering, product, and operations.
You'll work directly with our tax advisory teams to understand how they operate, identify high-impact opportunities for technology and automation, and build solutions that improve how work gets done.
Rather than building from abstract requirements, you'll work in tight feedback loops with users — understanding workflows, building MVPs fast, deploying them into production, and iterating based on real-world usage.
You're part engineer, part product thinker, and fully hands-on.
Your work will directly shape how our technology and agentic systems are deployed across the Limetax group.
What You'll Work On
Workflow Discovery. Work directly with tax professionals to understand complex operational workflows and identify where software and AI can have the biggest impact.
Rapid Prototyping. Turn operational problems into working MVPs quickly, test them with users, and iterate based on real-world feedback.
Product Engineering. Build software, internal tools, integrations, automations, and AI-enabled workflows that solve real problems across our firms.
Production Deployment. Take solutions beyond prototypes and deploy them into live operational environments.
Feedback & Iteration. Stay close to users after deployment, evaluate what works, and continuously improve the systems you build.
Scaling Solutions. Turn successful solutions into reliable, repeatable systems that can be rolled out across the Limetax group.
Cross-functional Execution. Work closely with founders, engineers, operators, and tax professionals to take projects from problem discovery through implementation.
Your Profile
You are a strong builder. You have shipped software, automations, or AI-enabled products that real users relied on and are comfortable working across APIs, databases, integrations, and modern development tools.
You have high agency. You don't wait for perfect requirements or a detailed playbook. You take ambiguous problems, figure out what matters, and drive them from discovery to production.
You are AI-native. You have built with LLMs, agents, or AI-enabled workflows and understand where AI creates real value — and where humans need to stay in the loop.
You work well with users. You communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, earn trust, and thrive in messy environments with imperfect data, legacy systems, and changing priorities.
You speak professional German and fluent English. German is essential for working directly with our tax advisory teams across Germany.
Why Limetax
Real-world impact. Build systems that are actively used in production and directly change how tax professionals work.
End-to-end ownership. Own problems from understanding the workflow to building, deploying, and improving the solution.
Tight feedback loops. Work directly with the people using what you build and see immediately where your solutions create value.
Build applied AI in production. Deploy AI against complex, real-world workflows rather than isolated demos or theoretical use cases.
Scale across the group. Build solutions in one environment and turn what works into systems that can be deployed across multiple firms.
Build at an early stage. Help shape the technology, products, and engineering practices that will define how Limetax scales.
Meaningful upside. Competitive cash compensation plus meaningful equity.

s.t: HPC Systems Software Engineer – OpenCHAMI for Lugano or Zürich (professione segnalata)

Questo progetto, con sede di lavoro a Lugano o a Zurigo, si concentra sullo sviluppo e il potenziamento di OpenCHAMI per l’infrastruttura di supercalcolo di nuova generazione del CSCS. Il lavoro contribuirà alla creazione di un approccio aperto, scalabile e moderno alla gestione dei cluster per sistemi di calcolo ad alte prestazioni (HPC) su larga scala.
L’obiettivo principale è progettare, sviluppare, integrare e implementare funzionalità di OpenCHAMI su misura per i requisiti operativi dei supercomputer del CSCS.
Il progetto affronterà le sfide legate alla gestione di sistemi HPC e di intelligenza artificiale (AI) sempre più complessi e contribuirà all’evoluzione delle tecnologie open source di gestione dei cluster di nuova generazione.

Offriamo un contratto iniziale di due anni che ti darà l’opportunità di lavorare all’avanguardia nell’ambito delle infrastrutture HPC e di intelligenza artificiale presso il CSCS, contribuendo direttamente allo sviluppo di tecnologie che supporteranno i futuri sistemi di supercalcolo.
Avrai l’opportunità di contribuire a OpenCHAMI e alle relative iniziative open source, collaborando con la più ampia comunità HPC e partecipando a programmi di grande impatto sia a livello nazionale che internazionale, tra cui HPSF, OpenCHAMI e iniziative correlate.

Sviluppare e ampliare OpenCHAMI per soddisfare i requisiti operativi e di gestione dell’infrastruttura dei sistemi di supercalcolo attuali e di prossima generazione del CSCS.
Contribuire all’ecosistema open source di OpenCHAMI, compresi lo sviluppo, l’integrazione e l’evoluzione dei servizi e dei componenti correlati alla gestione dei cluster.
Sviluppare flussi di lavoro di automazione e gestione per migliorare il provisioning, la configurazione, il monitoraggio, la manutenzione e l’efficienza operativa dei sistemi su larga scala.
Collaborare strettamente con i team operativi HPC per comprendere i requisiti e le sfide operative e tradurli in soluzioni basate su OpenCHAMI robuste, scalabili e di facile manutenzione.
Contribuire all’architettura e all’evoluzione della piattaforma OpenCHAMI, garantendo che le soluzioni siano scalabili, affidabili, gestibili e allineate alle esigenze dei sistemi HPC e di IA su larga scala.
Partecipare attivamente ai flussi di lavoro di sviluppo open source, tra cui la progettazione del software, l’implementazione, i test, le revisioni del codice, il tracciamento dei problemi e le discussioni tecniche all’interno della comunità OpenCHAMI.
Collaborare con partner internazionali e con la più ampia comunità HPC per sviluppare e integrare soluzioni che promuovano la gestione dei cluster open source e l’automazione delle infrastrutture.
Redigere e aggiornare la documentazione tecnica, inclusi progetti di architettura, guide all’implementazione, procedure operative e best practice.
Valutare tecnologie e approcci emergenti rilevanti per la gestione delle infrastrutture HPC, l’osservabilità e l’automazione, e contribuire alla loro adozione ove opportuno.

Accogliamo con favore ingegneri con background diversi che siano desiderosi di contribuire alla nostra missione. Cerchiamo principalmente solide basi tecniche, un buon giudizio ingegneristico e la capacità di colmare le lacune tra i diversi ambiti. Curiosità, adattabilità, disponibilità ad apprendere sul campo e potenziale di crescita contano per noi più di una perfetta corrispondenza iniziale con i requisiti tecnici.

Einleitungstext
The Swiss National Supercomputing Centre (CSCS) develops and operates a high-performance computing and data research infrastructure that supports world-class science in Switzerland. Its user laboratory is available to domestic and international researchers in academia, industry, and the business sector. The centre is operated by ETH Zurich and has offices at its data centre in Lugano and in Zurich.
Projekthintergrund

This project with work location either Lugano or Zürich focuses on the development and advancement of OpenCHAMI for CSCS’s next-generation supercomputing infrastructure. The work will contribute to building an open, scalable, and modern approach to cluster management for large-scale High Performance Computing (HPC) systems.
The main objective is to design, develop, integrate, and deploy OpenCHAMI capabilities tailored to the operational requirements of CSCS supercomputers.
The project will address the challenges of managing increasingly complex HPC and AI systems and contribute to the evolution of next-generation open-source cluster management technologies.

We value technical excellence, curiosity, initiative, and the ability to learn and grow over a perfect checklist of skills. Working on next-generation HPC infrastructure requires a willingness to explore new technologies, tackle complex problems, and continuously develop new expertise.
If you are motivated to make a meaningful impact in this area but do not meet every requirement, we strongly encourage you to apply.

We offer an initially two-year contract providing the opportunity to work at the forefront of HPC and AI infrastructure at CSCS, contributing directly to the development of technologies that will support future supercomputing systems.
You will have the opportunity to contribute to OpenCHAMI and related open-source initiatives, collaborating with the broader HPC community and contributing to high-impact programs at both the national and international levels, including HPSF, OpenCHAMI, and related initiatives.
This is an opportunity to help shape how future CSCS supercomputers are managed, monitored, and operated, while contributing to open-source technologies with an impact well beyond a single system or institution.
Aufgaben-/Stellenbeschreibung
Develop and extend OpenCHAMI to meet the infrastructure management and operational requirements of CSCS’s current and next-generation supercomputing systems.
Contribute to the OpenCHAMI open-source ecosystem, including the development, integration, and evolution of related cluster management services and components.
Develop automation and management workflows to improve system provisioning, configuration, monitoring, maintenance, and operational efficiency at scale.
Collaborate closely with HPC operations teams to understand operational requirements and challenges, and translate them into robust, scalable, and maintainable OpenCHAMI-based solutions.
Contribute to the architecture and evolution of the OpenCHAMI platform, ensuring that solutions are scalable, reliable, maintainable, and aligned with the needs of large-scale HPC and AI systems.
Participate actively in open-source development workflows, including software design, implementation, testing, code reviews, issue tracking, and technical discussions within the OpenCHAMI community.

We’re looking for someone who learns quickly, enjoys tackling unfamiliar problems, and can turn incomplete information into working solutions. You’ll have end-to-end ownership of your services, from investigating how they behave and deciding what needs to be built through implementation, testing, and ongoing improvements.
AI is a core part of how the team works. You’ll use modern AI coding and agentic tools to make development more efficient while maintaining the quality and reliability expected by LocalStack users. The role offers a clear path to broader service ownership and technical leadership as your scope grows.

Internalize services off moto. Independently take AWS services from moto-backed to fully first-party implementations, owning store design for persistence, full API operation coverage, and conformance to LocalStack conventions rather than transplanted moto code. Measured by services shipped and their size.
Close parity gaps in owned services. Raise snapshot-test coverage against real AWS for the documented API surface for owned services, with a measurable reduction in parity defects reported from the field.
Own services end-to-end after they ship. Act as first responder for their services: customer-reported parity bugs triaged and turned around within 5 days median, including those that surface through Terraform and CDK rather than direct API calls.
Raise the team's testing floor. Contribute reusable test infrastructure (conformance harnesses, snapshot tooling, fixtures) that other engineers adopt for services they do not own.

A software engineer today uses Claude Code or Cursor. A mechanical engineer designing the next jet engine still searches Excel sheets and asks whoever has been around longest.
We are building the AI co-engineer for physical products: one that works natively in 3D and learns from real engineering decisions. We are in production with major European manufacturers, with real revenue and customers who tell us when we are slow.
The problems are open ones. Getting an agent to reason usefully about geometry, making 3D search work on real customer part libraries, and figuring out what the interface even looks like when an engineer asks why a bracket failed. There is research to borrow from and very little product to copy.
Senior or staff level depending on experience.

You will own large problems end to end, across the stack. We cannot say exactly what that looks like in month three, but here is what the last two years have actually involved.
A multi-agent orchestration SDK , built from scratch . Nothing off the shelf handled what we needed: long-horizon execution that runs for hours and survives restarts.
CAD conversion as a real pipeline . It used to be manual and brittle. Turning it into production infrastructure meant writing a Python wrapper around a C++ SDK and making it reliable enough to sit under everything else.
Migrating the application off Electron and Webpack onto SSR React with Vite . That architecture is what the whole product now sits on.

3D-to-3D search across real customer part libraries, not benchmark datasets
Constraint solvers and optimization , and getting an agent to use one sensibly
Agents that hold a useful model of a physical object , which is still an open problem
Hybrid cloud deployments for manufacturers who cannot send their data anywhere
We work in Python and TypeScript, with multi-agent orchestration and AI integrations across several providers.

Your CV reads as a set of problems, not a stack
You use AI heavily to go faster, but you built things the hard way first

Staff Software Engineer, AI-Native Systems (Tech Lead)
Location: Remote (US)
We are
Virtual care only works if the infrastructure behind it does. Wheel builds that infrastructure — the systems that let telehealth run at scale for the patients, clinicians, and companies depending on it. We're not bolting AI onto old workflows; we're rebuilding them from the ground up.

Our mission to put great healthcare in everyone's reach means replacing manual, ad-hoc processes with intelligent, agent-powered systems that carry real operational load. We're innovating in a live, regulated healthcare environment where getting it right matters. This is the next architecture of virtual care, and we're building it now.
You are
A staff-level engineer who sets technical direction for agentic systems and then leads the work to ship them. You've built and operated agents in production, you know where they break, and you have opinions — held loosely, argued well — about how to build them so they hold up in a regulated environment.
You operate with the scope of a domain owner, not a task owner. You take a problem that isn't yet well-formed, define it, sequence it, and lead a group of engineers to a shipped and measured outcome. Your impact shows up in other people's work as much as your own: the patterns they reuse, the design decisions they don't have to relitigate, the ambiguity you removed before it cost the team a quarter.
You treat AI two ways at once — as a product capability you build with judgment, and as a development multiplier you use fluently — and you're the person who raises the org's bar on both.
The Work
Technical Leadership & Direction
Own the technical direction for a significant AI-native domain: agent architecture, platform abstractions, or evaluation and guardrail infrastructure.
Act as tech lead for a squad or a cross-team initiative — decomposing ambiguous problems, sequencing delivery, identifying and clearing blockers, and keeping the team pointed at the outcome rather than the ticket.
Write and review design docs; make and document the load-bearing architectural calls, including the ones where the answer is "not yet" or "buy, don't build."
Establish clear technical ownership where it's currently diffuse, so decisions have a named owner and reviews don't stall.
Agent Architecture & Engineering
Design and build production AI agents incorporating retrieval, orchestration, policy-based routing, tool invocation, evaluation harnesses, and lifecycle observability.
Set the standards for what "production-ready agent" means here — testability, rollback safety, cost ceilings, failure modes, human-in-the-loop boundaries — and hold the bar in review.
Take on the hardest parts of the build yourself. This is a hands-on role; you are expected to be in the code.
AI Platform Foundations
Build and extend the abstraction layers that let teams integrate AI capabilities cleanly and safely across our services.
Define the shared libraries, patterns, and guardrails other teams build on, and drive their adoption — a pattern nobody uses isn't a pattern.
Treat responsible use of AI on sensitive data as a hard engineering requirement, and translate privacy, security, and compliance constraints into concrete architecture rather than deferring them.
Cloud-Native Engineering
Own full-stack delivery in TypeScript/Node.js and Python: service and API layers, data-processing jobs, and the internal interfaces on top of them.
Leverage modern cloud infrastructure, event-driven patterns, CI/CD, and observability to deliver scalable AI-native systems.
Own deployment, monitoring, and troubleshooting in production, including on-call, and improve the operational posture of what you inherit.
Stakeholder Engagement & Advisory
Partner directly with product, operations, clinical operations, and business leaders as both technologist and trusted advisor — helping define which use cases are worth building and which aren't.
Lead design sessions, proofs of concept, and build-with sessions alongside the people who'll use the workflows, building trust and adoption as you go.
Communicate trade-offs, risks, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, up to and including the executive team.
Influence roadmap and prioritization with a clear-eyed read of technical risk, sequencing, and cost.
Measure & Improve
Own the evaluation strategy for your domain: define the metrics, test harnesses, and evaluation plans that measure agent accuracy, latency, safety, and cost-effectiveness.
Instrument the systems so their behavior is legible after the fact, not just at demo time.
Iterate rapidly on data, feedback, and changing requirements — and kill approaches that aren't working, early and visibly.
Growing the Org
Mentor and grow engineers through code review, design review, pairing, and direct feedback; make the people around you measurably better.
Craft reusable patterns, documentation, and best practices that raise the engineering bar beyond your own team.
Anchor our internal community of practice around AI-native and agentic engineering.
What success looks like
First 90 days: you have a working map of our AI platform surface area, have shipped something real, and have a point of view on where the leverage is.
First 6 months: you own a domain outright, are leading a team's technical direction within it, and there's an evaluation story for the agents you've shipped.
First year: patterns you established are in use by teams you don't sit on, and engineers point to you as the reason their work got better.

8+ years building and operating production software, with meaningful full-stack depth across a TypeScript/Node.js backend and at least one other language (Python strongly preferred).
A track record of technical leadership as an individual contributor: owning a domain, leading multi-engineer efforts to completion, and driving decisions across team boundaries without positional authority.
Hands-on experience designing and deploying agentic systems in production — retrieval, orchestration, tool/function calling, and evaluation — with a clear-eyed view of where LLMs and agents work and where they don't.
Demonstrated ability to take a loosely defined problem and drive it to a shipped, measured, agent-powered workflow.
A working practice of using AI development tools as a force multiplier, with judgment about when to trust, verify, or override them.
Strong cloud-native engineering fundamentals; comfort with CI/CD, observability, and running what you build.
Fluency with relational data and SQL.
Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to write a design doc that changes minds. This is a remote, cross-functional role.
Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward shipping measurable results.
Strongly desired
Experience with agent frameworks and multi-agent architectures at production scale.
Model evaluation and guardrail infrastructure — measuring output quality, catching regressions, keeping agents inside safe bounds.
Experience building platform capabilities consumed by other engineering teams.

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
Over 50 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products to turn whatever they’re reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.
Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office.

The Platform team owns the backend behind everything Speechify ships: the public TTS API, payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption tracking, and analytics — serving over 50 million users across iOS, Android, Mac, Chrome, and web.
These are systems where correctness compounds. Subscription state has to stay consistent across five clients and two app-store billing systems that each go quiet at the worst moment. Consumption metering has to be exact enough to bill on and cheap enough to run at our request volume. The public TTS API has external customers with their own products depending on our latency and uptime. None of this degrades gracefully — it is either right, or someone gets charged twice.
The job is to make your own job smaller. Every system you own here should need less of you a year from now than it did the day you took it, and the reward for that is a larger one. That is the entire growth path on this team — there is no separate ladder, and no ceiling except the one you stop raising. We are a flat organization: people become leaders here by taking scope and being right about it, fast.

Wanna join the adventure?
Loft’s Onboard Software group provides the on-orbit software that powers our satellite fleet — from the Linux services running on the Hub’s onboard computers, to the containerized workloads executing customer applications in low Earth orbit.
The Peripheral Services team owns the software that integrates third-party devices and payloads into Loft’s standardized satellite platform. We enable the control and monitoring of many key spacecraft components, including optical payloads, radios, power controllers, and GNSS receivers. Many of these components are reused across all satellite programs and form the building blocks of our onboard architecture.
The applications developed by our team handle the low-level communication protocol details, exposing the connected devices behind standardized APIs used across mission operations. The team is also responsible for the automation and orchestration that allows Loft to safely and reliably operate the equipment at scale.
In this role, you’ll help develop the software that connects diverse spacecraft hardware to the rest of the platform, and ultimately enables successful missions in orbit.

Design, implement, and refine software with a high degree of ownership, driving impactful features from concept through delivery while ensuring robustness and reliability.
Review code, provide clear feedback, and enforce adherence to established development processes, style guides, and design standards to maintain consistency and quality across the codebase.
Design and implement unit and integration tests for both self-authored and peer-authored code.
Utilize version control systems to create feature branches, push code, and merge approved code into production branches.
Contribute to the onboard software architecture through design proposals and collaborative review
Participate in the review and enhancement of software development processes and design standards.
Coordinate with downstream teams on the distribution and adoption of the latest releases.
In addition to responsibilities within onboard software, you’ll have the opportunity to directly be involved in operating our on-orbit fleet of satellites.

Au cœur de l’entité Decathlon Digital, l'équipe Data Platform recherche un·e Staff Software Engineer basé·e à Lille .
Pour accélérer la transformation de nos infrastructures et répondre aux enjeux d'évolutivité, nous avons créé une équipe SWAT constituée d'experts seniors et de Staff Engineers.
En tant que Staff Software Engineer , ta mission sera d'apporter l'excellence du génie logiciel sur l'ensemble du périmètre de la Data Platform. Tu navigueras de manière transverse entre nos différentes équipes (Factory, Core Data Product - CDP, MLOps, Platform Engineering) pour poser les standards logiciels, concevoir les briques d'infrastructure et garantir l'excellence technique.

En tant que Staff Software Engineer, tu seras le·la garant·e de l’excellence logicielle, de la robustesse de l'écosystème et de l'interopérabilité des plateformes.

s.h: Excellence Software & Gouvernance des Applications Factory
s.t:
Tu standardises nos méthodes de software engineering pour l'ensemble de la Data & AI Platform et t'appuies sur les communautés d'experts du digital Decathlon pour y diffuser les meilleures pratiques.
Tu apportes un cadre logiciel rigoureux aux applications clés développées côté Factory, notamment ARC et le Data Contract Registry.

Tu développes les briques logicielles complexes et exigeantes (APIs, SDKs internes, microservices) pour outiller les squads Data, MLOps et GenAI. Tu conçois l'architecture technique assurant l'interconnexion fluide, sécurisée et performante pour l'agentic platform.

Tu garantis la haute disponibilité, la sécurité et la scalabilité de ces APIs afin de fluidifier les usages opérationnels et applicatifs.
Fort·e de tes connaissances sur l'écosystème Kafka / Streaming, tu explores et expérimentes de nouvelles architectures d'Analytics Engineering en temps réel.
Tu orientes les choix d'architecture avec un réflexe FinOps fort, en optimisant continuellement les performances d'exécution dbt / Databricks et les coûts d'infrastructures associées.
Tu joues un rôle de sentinelle en identifiant de manière proactive la dette technique sur l'ensemble de la Data Platform et en orchestrant son assainissement avec les équipes produit et ingénierie.
